audience: e-commerce and marketing teams that run email lists in SmartrMail

useCases.title: Check which subscriber lists exist
useCases.text: List all subscriber lists with their subscriber counts. Open one list to see its name and count.

useCases.title: Look up one subscriber
useCases.text: Find a subscriber by email address, phone number or UID. Read the subscribed state, open and click counts, and custom fields.

useCases.title: Create or rename a subscriber list
useCases.text: Create a new subscriber list with a name, or rename an existing list.

useCases.title: Update a subscriber's details
useCases.text: Change a subscriber's name, phone number, subscribed flag or custom fields. Only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Unsubscribe or resubscribe an address
useCases.text: Stop campaigns for an address that asked to be removed, or subscribe it again. Custom field data stays.
